description: This file appears to be a shell script used for inspecting and validating documentation and command documentation consistency within a project's structure. It contains functions for extracting variables from Makefiles, checking for missing documentation, and verifying that documentation files are correctly linked and listed.

methods.name: extract_variable
methods.description: Extracts the value of a variable from the Makefile and associated command list, using make and sed.

methods.name: check_missing_docs
methods.description: Checks whether command documentation files and links exist for each command listed.

methods.name: check_extraneous_docs
methods.description: Verifies that documentation files correspond to known commands and are properly listed.
